acceptanceCriteria: Ladder tests run offline against the fake runner in the ordinary go test lane.
A CI lane runs the live prove tests and its result is visible on PRs touching internal/changee2e.
body: Expert panel 2026-10-17 (six read-only lenses, docs/build-log/2026-10-17-cce-expert-panel.md) on CCE-V0 (docs/specs/change-compiled-e2e-v0.md) toward the owner goal: compile the E2E test that checks a change, on demand, and eventually replace hosted suites. The live CCE prove tests need Node and Playwright and no CI lane runs them, so the verdict ladder is unqualified in CI. Add an offline fake runner that replays recorded receipts for deterministic ladder tests, and a CI lane that runs the live tests where browsers are available.
title: CCE: live prove tests run in no CI lane; add a CI lane and an offline fake runner
